title: 第10章 我没妈！
slug: 皇家县令我每日躺着收税
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

走出钱家正厅，张宁就像是川剧变脸似地，脸上的怒意消失不见，取而代之的，是满脸的喜色。

“钱世伯果然大方，初次见面，竟然就送了本县这么多银两。”

“本县若不能在此地，做一番惊天动地的大事业，都对不起钱世伯给的这些银子。”

“……”

甚至还逢人，就故意拍拍那沉甸甸的布袋，也不知是真心，还是阴阳怪气地大声嚷嚷，引来一众仆人，诧异的目光。

老爷这是给了这位新来的县令多少银子，竟把人乐成了这样？

姓钱的老登，既然想用这些铜钱羞辱我，那礼尚往来，本县就送你一口洗不清的黑锅吧。

其实他方才根本就没生气，毕竟，他今日来此，要了多少钱不重要，但要没要到钱，以及让人知道他要到钱了，才是重中之重。

直到来到钱家大门处，张宁才收起布袋，准备召唤统子哥。

但就在这时，一个一袭白衣，盘着长发的女人，从门外走了进来。

张宁动作一僵，又拍起了布袋，下意识大声表演起来，“钱世伯实在是太……”

“啪！”

然而，待看到这女人的长相后，张宁竟把到了嘴边的话，全都忘了，只顾着盯着女人的脸发呆，甚至连布袋掉落，都没有察觉。

女人二十左右岁的年纪，气质清冷，明明站在面前，却像是从画中走出来的仙女一样。

“啊！”女人也没想到，会突然有个这么冒失的人，下意识发出一声轻呼。

“我去，就连受惊的样子，都这么好看！”张宁看得更呆了。

女人：“……”

她顿时柳眉轻蹙，但还是冲着张宁微一弯身，然后才像是身后有鬼一样，头也不回地急匆匆离去。

【叮咚！】

【检测到宿主春心萌动，求偶心极其强烈，请宿主务必生个孩子！】

张宁：“……”

他这才从女人即将消失的背影上，收回目光，没好气地在心底说道：“色统子，春心萌动你大爷，我刚才那是装的。”

一个还没进门，就问“此宅中可有妙龄女子”的小色批，见到个一眼惊艳的美女，不像个痴汉似的，那才叫有问题。

【宿主果然诡计多端，老奸巨猾！】

张宁：“……”

Page (1/3)

Walking out of the main hall of Qian's house, Zhang Ning seemed to be changing his face in a Sichuan opera. The anger on his face disappeared and was replaced by a face full of joy.

"Qian Shibo is really generous. When we first met, he gave so much silver from the county."

"If this county cannot do something earth-shattering here, it will not be able to afford the money given by Qian Shibo."

"..."

Even when he met someone, he deliberately patted the heavy cloth bag. I don't know if he was sincere or just yelling out of spite, which attracted surprised looks from all the servants.

How much money did the master give to this new county magistrate to make him happy like this?

Lao Deng, surnamed Qian, since you want to use these copper coins to humiliate me, then as a courtesy, this county will give you a scapegoat that cannot be cleaned up.

In fact, he wasn't angry at all just now. After all, he was here today. It didn't matter how much money he asked for, but whether he got the money and letting people know that he was going to get the money was the most important thing.

It wasn't until he arrived at the gate of Qian's house that Zhang Ning put away the bag and prepared to summon Brother Tongzi.

But at this moment, a woman dressed in white with long hair walked in from the door.

Zhang Ning froze, patted the bag again, and subconsciously started to act loudly, "Qian Shibo is really too..."

"Crack!"

However, after seeing the woman's appearance, Zhang Ning forgot all the words he said and just stared at the woman's face in a daze, not even noticing the bag falling.

The woman is about 20 years old, with a cold temperament. Although she is standing in front of her, she looks like a fairy walking out of a painting.

"Ah!" The woman didn't expect that such a reckless person would suddenly appear, so she subconsciously let out a soft cry.

"Here, even the frightened look looks so good!" Zhang Ning was even more stunned.

Woman: "..."

She frowned slightly, but she still bent slightly toward Zhang Ning, and then hurried away without looking back, as if there was a ghost behind her.

[Ding dong!】

[It has been detected that the host’s lust is budding, and the desire for mating is extremely strong. Please be sure to have a child!】

Zhang Ning: "..."

Only then did he look away from the woman's disappearing figure, and said angrily in his heart: "Se Tongzi, I'm attracted to your uncle, I was just pretending."

A little girl who asked "Are there any young women in this house" before entering the house? If he saw a beautiful woman who was stunning at first glance, and she didn't look like a crazy person, that would be a problem.

[The host is indeed very cunning and cunning!】

Zhang Ning: "..."
